words.gloss: to accept / to form an estimate

literal: Good qualities having examined, faults also having examined, among them the excess having examined, that which is greater, to accept.
translation: Weigh a person's merits and weigh their faults; then, assessing which of the two is greater, form your judgment of them.
modern: ஒருவருடைய நற்குணங்களை ஆராய்ந்து, அவருடைய குற்றங்களையும் ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றுள் எது அதிகமாக இருக்கிறதோ அதை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு அவரைப் பற்றி முடிவு செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet provides a highly practical and realistic method for evaluating people before placing trust or responsibility in them. The author advises us to first examine a person's virtues (குணம்) and then objectively examine their faults (குற்றம்). Since no human is entirely perfect, we must compare the two and see which side outweighs the other (மிகை). Our final decision to accept or trust them (கொளல்) should be based on whichever side is predominant (மிக்க).
